_meta.note: Reference numbers for the interactive Growth-Plan dashboard (the 'see how I make this better' story). Sourced 2026-08 via research agents. STAGED, not yet wired into a page. Everything here is a benchmark/model, labeled as illustration — never a guarantee.
honesty_rules: Lifts are NOT additive/stackable — combining mechanisms overlaps; discount, don't multiply. Blended booking uplift ~1.5-2.5x, driven mostly by speed-to-lead + reviews.
Total Eyeballs = gross impressions (times shown), NOT unique people. GBP/organic-web/organic-social overlap heavily; apply a ~40-70% de-dupe haircut for approximate unique reach.
Google SEARCH ads reach honestly ~2-3 impressions/$ (high CTR => effective CPM ~$490); the 30-80/$ figure blends in Display/PMax and overstates search-text eyeballs.
LSA impressions/$ is modeled from CPL and an assumed view->lead rate; weakest number here.
Every projected result is an illustration of market rates, not a guarantee; varies by trade, market, season, ticket size, and execution.
